summary: Invardia support holds database admin rights only while a support session is open.

fixes.title: Support database access is time-limited
fixes.text: While a support session is open, the Invardia Support app is a database administrator only until the session ends, at most 24 hours.

fixes.title: Guards never hold back an update
fixes.text: Strict mode only lowers PIM Manager's own change limits; it never blocks an update.
